description: ACTION on the WooCommerce store. Sets the stock quantity of one product or variation (enables stock management on it). Returns before → after. In safe mode the first call returns a PREVIEW with confirm_id: show it and call again with confirm_id only after the user approves.

confirm_id.description: Token di conferma ritornato dall'anteprima. Ripassa lo STESSO payload + confirm_id per eseguire davvero la scrittura.

variation_id.description: For a variation of a variable product

name: woo_update_stock
